decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted C726?AC?120?B1?DR?Z?1901 Rev P1; C726?AC?120?B1?DR?Z?1902 Rev P1; C726?AC?120?B1?DR?Z?1903 Rev P1; C726?AC?120?B1?DR?Z?1904 Rev P1; C726?AC?120?B1?DR?Z?1905 Rev P1; Air Quality Report; Planning, Design and Access Statement; Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment; Received 01/10/2015; Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment Further Addendum; Received 16/11/2015; Noise Assessment; Received 08/12/2015; therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before the development hereby permitted commences, a study and details/samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surface of the flue hereby permitted shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be completed in accordance with these approved details.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted commences, a scheme showing proposed landscaping, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme so approved shall be carried out in the first planting and/or seeding season following the first occupation of the building(s)/commencement of the use and shall comply with the requirements specified in BS 3936 (1992) 'Specification of Nursery Stock Part 1 Trees and Shrubs', and in BS 4428 (1989) 'Recommendations for General Landscape Operations'. None of the new trees, plants or shrubs planted shall be lopped or topped within a period of five years from the completion of the development. Any trees, plants or shrubs, which, within a period of five years from the completion of the development die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased shall be replaced in the next planting season, in accordance with the approved scheme. The approved landscaping scheme shall be maintained thereafter.
Condition : 5 - All planting on and around the site shall be of locally native plant species only, of UK genetic origin.

Condition : 6 - The rating level of sound emitted from any fixed plant and/or machinery associated with the development shall not exceed background sound levels by more than 5dB(A) between the hours of 0700-2300 (taken as a 15 minute LA90 at the nearest sound sensitive premises) and shall not exceed the background sound level between 2300-0700 (taken as a 15 minute LA90 at the nearest sound sensitive premises). 

Once operational, an assessment of the site shall be carried out in accordance with the methodology of BS4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/or its subsequent amendments.

o Measurements of the specific noise levels must be taken as close to the noise source as practical to minimise contributions from other noise sources. 
o The background sound levels, in the absence of the specific noise from the proposed plant, have been reported in the Noise Report (document ref. 5140284/2015/Dec/04) and should be referred to as part of any further assessments.

Condition : 7 - No construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Before the development hereby permitted commences at the site, a scheme demonstrating that the new proposed plant design achieves 20% reduction in Nitrogen Dioxide concentration levels at sensitive receptors by means of a diffusion tube study shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The applicant may use their own submitted baseline data or that of the Council. The approved scheme shall be completed before the flue stack hereby is first used, and shall be permanently retained thereafter, in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of 26m free-standing multi flue stack and 5.2m high sampling access platform
